integrity: The universal recurrence is proved by an exact rank dichotomy for a bordered alternating matrix. Character consequences use the published all-characteristic character-rank formula. Bounded exhaustive computation is used only as an independent replay.
scientific_limitations: The recurrence applies to adjoining universal vertices, not to arbitrary graph joins.
The bordered-alternating rank lemma is elementary; the new content is the exact rank-distribution transformation and its graphical-group character consequences.
An equivalent statement could exist under bordered alternating-matrix terminology not located in the literature search.
title: Coning recurrence for character degrees of graphical groups
